title: Historia, Geografía y Ciencias Sociales — Texto del Estudiante (Básico)
scopeStatement: En este Texto del Estudiante se abordan contenidos, habilidades y actitudes mediante diversos tipos de recursos y fuentes.
curriculumClaim: Historia universal y geografía — Edad Media y mundo medieval
readingStatus: partial — Unit 3 only (pp. 110–119 confirmed). Units 1, 2, 4+ not yet reviewed.
notes: State-aligned Chilean textbook (Decreto Supremo N° 614/2013). Published by SM. Integrated social sciences structure. Unit 3 focuses on European Middle Ages (commercial and urban expansion). No non-European civilisations treated as subjects in reviewed pages.

title: Всемирная история. 6 класс
curriculumAuthority: Ministry of Education of the Republic of Belarus
curriculumClaim: Всемирная история (implied global scope through title and curriculum positioning)
notes: State-approved Belarusian Grade 6 world history textbook. Likely covers Ancient to Medieval period. Requires TOC and chapter verification for 13th-century coverage.

title: History Student Textbook Grade 9
curriculumAuthority: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, Ministry of Education
curriculumClaim: Implied global scope through inclusion of Africa, Asia, Europe, and Latin America in table of contents
notes: Strong African-centered structure. Contains both global history and dedicated regional unit on Ethiopia and the Horn to the end of the 13th century.

title: 世界历史 九年级 上册
scopeStatement: 《义务教育教科书 世界历史》(九年级)由教育部组织编写
curriculumClaim: 国家统一编写的义务教育世界历史教材
curriculumAuthority: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China
publisher: 人民教育出版社 (People’s Education Press)
notes: Highly centralized national textbook produced under direct Ministry of Education supervision with input from academic historians and teaching experts. Standardized narrative aligned with national curriculum and ideological framework.

title: 세계사
curriculumClaim: High school world history textbook organized by major world regions and modern global transformations.
curriculumAuthority: Ministry of Education of the Republic of Korea; authorization review conducted by the Korea Institute for Curriculum and Evaluation
notes: State-reviewed high school world history textbook. The author team combines university historians/history educators and current school teachers. The table of contents structures world history by regions (East Asia, West Asia and India, Europe and the Americas) and by major global periods such as imperialism, the world wars, and the contemporary world.

title: Lịch sử 10
curriculumClaim: State-issued secondary history textbook covering both Vietnamese and world history within a standardized national curriculum.
curriculumAuthority: Ministry of Education and Training of Vietnam
publisher: Nhà xuất bản Giáo dục Việt Nam
notes: Official state-issued Grade 10 history textbook. Produced under direct authority of the Ministry of Education and Training, with centralized editorial oversight. The structure typically integrates national history and world history within a unified curriculum.

title: Всеобщая история. История Средних веков. 6 класс
titleTranslated: World History. History of the Middle Ages. Grade 6
curriculumClaim: State-approved world history textbook focusing on the Middle Ages as a global historical period.
curriculumAuthority: Ministry of Education of the Russian Federation
notes: Grade 6 textbook on medieval world history. Officially approved by the Ministry of Education of the Russian Federation. Focuses on the Middle Ages as a distinct historical period within world history rather than a fully global continuous narrative.

title: Jahon tarixi 8
curriculumClaim: General secondary education world history textbook approved by the Ministry of Preschool and School Education of Uzbekistan.
curriculumAuthority: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Maktabgacha va maktab ta’limi vazirligi
notes: Grade 8 world history textbook covering medieval to early modern global history with regional sections on Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas. Strong chronological-period structure (13th–15th centuries emphasized). State-developed and approved for general secondary education.

title: History Student’s Book 3
curriculumClaim: Covers the Secondary 3 national syllabus developed by the Ministry of General Education and Instruction.
curriculumAuthority: Ministry of General Education and Instruction, Republic of South Sudan
authors: Ministry of General Education and Instruction
notes: Secondary-level history textbook combining global civilisations (Egypt, China, Aztec, Inca) with national framing. Explicitly aligned to state syllabus and designed to develop practical and collaborative learning skills. Represents a state-produced curriculum delivered via a commercial regional publisher.

title: Всемирная история. 7 класс
curriculumClaim: Developed according to the subject programme 'World History' for grades 7–9 (updated content, 2015 version).
curriculumAuthority: Nazarbayev Intellectual Schools (NIS) in alignment with national education standards
notes: World history textbook for Grade 7 developed under the Nazarbayev Intellectual Schools programme with collaboration from international curriculum partners (University of Cambridge/University College London). Explicit global scope claim makes it suitable for historiographical coverage analysis.

title: История и цивилизации за 6. клас
curriculumClaim: Учебник по история и цивилизации за 6. клас, съобразен с българската учебна програма
notes: Integrated history textbook combining European medieval history with extensive national Bulgarian history. Strong emphasis on Bulgaria (state formation, царе, Ottoman period) alongside broader regional and European developments.

title: Всесвітня історія
curriculumClaim: Підручник створено відповідно до модельної навчальної програми «Всесвітня історія. 7—9 класи»
notes: State-approved world history textbook covering the medieval period (V–XV centuries) with an explicitly global framing but structured around major regions and themes. Includes interactive digital supplement.
